description: This file defines classes representing various nodes in a DOM tree of an HTML document, including generic nodes, specific element nodes like tags and text, as well as utility classes for processing and comparing HTML structures within a difference engine context.

classes.name: Node
classes.description: Base class representing a node in the DOM tree, providing methods for parent hierarchy navigation and common node operations.

classes.name: TagNode
classes.description: Represents an element node, corresponding to an HTML tag, capable of containing child nodes and attributes.

classes.name: TextNode
classes.description: Represents a text piece within the HTML content.

classes.name: WhiteSpaceNode
classes.description: A specialized TextNode that represents whitespace, inheriting properties from TextNode.

classes.name: BodyNode
classes.description: Represents the root body of an HTML document, extending TagNode.

classes.name: VisibleTagNode
classes.description: Represents visible media elements like images within HTML, extending TextNode.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor for initializing the node with a parent.

methods.name: getParentTree
methods.description: Returns the hierarchy of parent nodes from this node up to the root.

methods.name: getLastCommonParent
methods.description: Finds the last common ancestor node between this node and another node.

methods.name: setParent
methods.description: Sets the parent node for the current node.

methods.name: inPre
methods.description: Checks if this node is within a preformatted block.

methods.name: addChildAbsolute
methods.description: Adds a child node at a specific index.

methods.name: getIndexOf
methods.description: Returns the index of a specific child node.

methods.name: getNbChildren
methods.description: Returns the number of child nodes.

methods.name: getMinimalDeletedSet
methods.description: Returns minimal set of nodes marked for deletion based on a given ID.

methods.name: splitUntil
methods.description: Splits the node hierarchy until a specified condition is met.

methods.name: copyTree
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the node and its children.

methods.name: expandWhiteSpace
methods.description: Expands whitespace within a TagNode, adding whitespace nodes where necessary.

methods.name: getLeftMostChild
methods.description: Returns the leftmost descendant node.

methods.name: getRightMostChild
methods.description: Returns the rightmost descendant node.

methods.name: isPre
methods.description: Checks if this node is a preformatted text block.

methods.name: toDiffLine
methods.description: Returns a diff-compatible representation of a node.

methods.name: getMatchRatio
methods.description: Computes the similarity ratio between two TagNodes.

methods.name: copyTree
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the entire subtree.

methods.name: getLeftMostChild
methods.description: Recursively retrieves the leftmost descendant.

methods.name: getRightMostChild
methods.description: Recursively retrieves the rightmost descendant.

methods.name: isSameText
methods.description: Checks if another TextNode has the same text content.
